description:
SpaceGuard Africa is a multidisciplinary team participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 to develop an innovative space technology solution that addresses climate resilience and environmental challenges in Africa.
Our team is passionate about Artificial Intelligence (AI), IoT, embedded systems, software development, data science, climate innovation, and Earth observation. We are committed to building a practical prototype that demonstrates how space technology can support communities through intelligent environmental monitoring and data-driven decision support.
We believe in teamwork, creativity, and solving real-world challenges using science and technology. We welcome collaboration, knowledge sharing, and innovative thinking throughout the hackathon.
